title: Stroke Is Fatal for Mrs. Rebecca Blakey
text:
Stroke Is Fatal for
Mrs. Rebecca Blakey

SAVOY — Funeral will be held Thursday at 2:30 p. m. in Savoy Methodist Church for Mrs. Rebecca F. Blakey, 85, native of Savoy, who died in a rest home, here, Wednesday at 4:40 a. m., the result of a stroke suffered two weeks ago.

Rev. W. L. Douglas, pastor, will officiate. Burial will be in Sunnyside Cemetery, near Savoy, directed by Earnheart Funeral Home of Whitewright.

Mrs. Blakey was a daughter of the late James M. and Jackie A. Wrenn, and wife of the late Robert S. Blakey. She had been a member of the Methodist Church for 50 years, and attended old Savoy Halsell College.

Survivors are one daughter, Mrs. R. C. Elk of Savoy; two sons, Tom and Clyde Blakey, both of Savoy; 14 grandchildren, 28 great-grandchildren and four great-great-grandchildren.

Pallbearers will be George Blakey, Earl Blakey, Gene Blakey, Noble Blakey, Edison Blakey and Jess Blakey, all nephews of the deceased.
